_comment: Benchmark configuration for choosing the tutor (LLM1) and evaluator (LLM2) models.
candidates lists model ids EXPLICITLY. Nothing substitutes a different model: a
candidate that is withdrawn or no longer free is reported by
tools/check_models.py and the benchmark refuses to run it. That is not
theoretical — five of the first six ids seeded here were wrong and were caught
by exactly this check, which is why no id below was written from memory.
'openrouter/free' is deliberately NOT a candidate. It picks a model at random
per request, so a run cannot be reproduced. It does appear in the catalogue's
free list and tools/check_models.py --list-free shows it there; it is excluded
here.
Regenerate the full list of what is free right now with
python3 tools/check_models.py --list-free
then curate. Do not hand-write ids from memory and do not assume a ':free'
variant exists for a given model — it does not, and asking for one that does
not returns 404.
'expect_free' is checked at run time. A candidate still listed but now charging
money is reported as a problem rather than quietly paid for.
verify_before_running: every candidate is resolved against the live catalogue
before any call, so an unusable id is caught before it burns a benchmark slot.

excluded_from_candidates.openrouter/free: random per-request router; a run cannot be reproduced
excluded_from_candidates.google/lyria-3-clip-preview: audio generation, not a text instruction model
excluded_from_candidates.google/lyria-3-pro-preview: audio generation, not a text instruction model
excluded_from_candidates.cohere/north-mini-code:free: code-focused; kept as a free-tier smoke test only

candidates.note: general instruction model advertising structured output
smaller sibling of the above, to separate size from family
small and fast; the floor for cost and latency
very large, no advertised structured output
general model, no advertised structured output

_comment: temperature 0 and a fixed task order keep the run comparable. A model is called
once per task with identical inputs; nothing retries a different prompt.
max_tokens 700 is a deliberate ceiling applied identically to every model.
A reasoning model that spends it without emitting content is recorded as
truncated/empty rather than retried, so a weak setting is not hidden by a
generous one.
Pinning the provider matters for reproducibility: the same model id can be served
by different upstreams, which changes latency and occasionally the output. Set
order to a specific provider id to pin harder. Free models often have only one.

results._comment: One record per (model, task), including failures. Appended, never rewritten.

summary._comment: Per-model aggregate for the latest run; the JSONL above holds the history.

usage_log._comment: Every call is also recorded here for cost control, independently of benchmark results.
